title: What are alternatives to the Oscars and Hollywood industry?

commenti.body:
Bruh— you saw a propaganda film about a salacious and false presentation of human trafficking that galvanizes a man who used his bullshit to con women into sexual situations with him. 

I would rather see Ant-Man and the Wasp get Best Picture.

I’m sorry, but are children around the world not facing that reality? How is that propaganda? Think what you will about the network but that movie speaks for itself. 

Well it technically could have lol. Black Panther got a nomination remember?

Human trafficking is a very broad umbrella that speaks to a lot of things. There are definitely children who are trafficked, but not in the salacious manner the film presents. 

Black Panther was a pretty good movie that wasn’t about a guy who manipulated women who he then abused. Once again, the  hero of the film is an abuser.

Gonna assume you’re a bot and move on.

The Oscars are an industry award and have never been about what is truly the best film. It's voted on by people that work in the industry, with all the favoritism or disinterest that implies. And yeah, people sometimes pick what they want to win because of the message it will send over which film is actually the best, although some actually vote on quality. It's great marketing for the industry, and once you've gotten one of the awards your name is rarely mentioned without also saying you won. Generally awards are fairly meaningless though.

Most other awards are given by critics - who actually see all the films - or by awards bodies at film festival who see all the films in the festival. But they don't have the insider marketing that the Academy Awards does so you don't hear about them as much.

National Society of Film Critics: [https://nationalsocietyoffilmcritics.com/](https://nationalsocietyoffilmcritics.com/)

BAFTA is the British Academy Awards: [https://www.bafta.org/](https://www.bafta.org/)

The Golden Globes tries to match the prestige of the Academy Awards: [https://goldenglobes.com/](https://goldenglobes.com/)

Most film festivals have awards too. Cannes is the big one but Venice, Sundance, Toronto, and Austin are notable. Cannes is a good one for foreign films: [https://cannesfilmawards.com/winners/2023](https://cannesfilmawards.com/winners/2023)

But the best awards are the Razzies: [https://www.razzies.com/index.html](https://www.razzies.com/index.html)

It’s a movie. Not all movies are historically accurate but they usually push audiences to seek the real story. It’s common with a lot of historical films or biopics. I disagree with BP. It was a hollow superhero film that was only popularized because of the targeted demographic and the death of the main actor. I liked some parts but it still falls under the category of what Martin Scorsese labeled them. You’re letting your political ideas cloud your opinion. Muted.
